d: The ed-tech sector in India has been flourishing in India for a long time. But the Covid-19 pandmeic has led to exponential growth in the adoption of online education like never before. One company, Byju’s, took advantage of this growth, and became one of the world’s top 10 education apps downloaded in this lockdown. But there’s something wrong with this immense growth of Byju’s that cannot be ignored. So Let's discuss the problems associated with Byju’s and how we can solve them.
